      Analyze your own swings

      This site shows Matteo's and Wilson's swings. To analyze your own, download SwingLab and run it on your computer.

      Download ZIP

      Or clone it:

      Then double-click start.bat (Windows) or run ./start.sh (Mac or Linux). That installs what SwingLab needs and opens this same viewer.

      Recording needs an iPhone Pro with LiDAR, and the Record3D app with the RGBD export add-on. Recording instructions

      The coach chat also runs only on your computer, where your own swings stay.

      New hitter

      Height, weight, age and level adjust the scores for body size. Changes apply to swings analyzed from now on.
